1.web: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
1.asv: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassions,

2.web: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
2.asv: make full my joy, that ye be of the same mind, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

3.web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
3.asv: doing nothing through faction or through vainglory, but in lowliness of mind each counting other better than himself;

4.web: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
4.asv: not looking each of you to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

5.web: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
5.asv: Have this mind in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

6.web: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
6.asv: who, existing in the form of God, counted not the being on an equality with God a thing to be grasped,

7.web: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
7.asv: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men;

8.web: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.
8.asv: and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, becoming obedient even unto death, yea, the death of the cross.

9.web: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;
9.asv: Wherefore also God highly exalted him, and gave unto him the name which is above every name;

10.web: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
10.asv: that in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven and things on earth and things under the earth,

11.web: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
11.asv: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

12.web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
12.asv: So then, my beloved, even as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;

13.web: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
13.asv: for it is God who worketh in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.

14.web: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,
14.asv: Do all things without murmurings and questionings:

15.web: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
15.asv: that ye may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom ye are seen as lights in the world,

16.web: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
16.asv: holding forth the word of life; that I may have whereof to glory in the day of Christ, that I did not run in vain neither labor in vain.

17.web: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.
17.asv: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all:

18.web: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.
18.asv: and in the same manner do ye also joy, and rejoice with me.

19.web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
19.asv: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

20.web: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
20.asv: For I have no man likeminded, who will care truly for your state.

21.web: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
21.asv: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

22.web: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
22.asv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a child serveth a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the gospel.

23.web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
23.asv: Him therefore I hope to send forthwith, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me:

24.web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
24.asv: but I trust in the Lord that I myself also shall come shortly.

25.web: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;
25.asv: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker and fellow-soldier, and your messenger and minister to my need;

26.web: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.
26.asv: since he longed after you all, and was sore troubled, because ye had heard that he was sick:

27.web: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
27.asv: for indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.

28.web: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
28.asv: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

29.web: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,
29.asv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy; and hold such in honor:

30.web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
30.asv: because for the work of Christ he came nigh unto death, hazarding his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
